notes.title: Summoning Bosses & MUUUCH MORE!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206668/64d1e9d6c470cfe68ffe04f409d85a87a16bb658.png"][/img][/p][p][b][i]SUMMONING STONES ADDED[/i][/b][i] - Find the first one by the Tribal Shaman in World 6![/i][/p][p]• Click the stones to FIGHT BOSSES! Defeating these bosses give a new Winner's Bonus of 2x MULTIPLIER to ALL SUMMONING UPGRADES of that color![/p][p]• You can fight more than once! Being a 2-time champ will net you a sweet 3x multi. 3-peating will get you a sweet 4x mutli...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206668/56c9d3d0e5a4f9d609474229a76a5867e5333f30.png"][/img][/p][p][i]There are 7 STONES to click on, each with a fearsome boss and awesome Winner's Bonus![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206668/b629f40a57086d83b7af8005cfe9f0b93da84c62.png"][/img][/p][p][i]NEW TROPHY - Complete Potti's new quests (NPC in World 6) to earn this trophy![/i][/p][p][/p][h1]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h1][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/EPssMcs.png"][/img][/p][p]• Summoning Stones are FINALLY here, with 7 of them found throughout the IdleOn worlds! These stones are a BOSS mode, where you must defeat a slow-moving GIANT before he reaches your end. [/p][p]• If you win, you'll get an amazing new winner's bonus of a new 2x multiplier to all* bonuses of that stone type! [i](NOTE: not quite all. Only bonuses that can be doubled by Summoning Doublers are affects.)[/i][/p][p]• Summoning Stone Bosses can be fought more than once... but be prepared to deal BILLIONS of damage if you want to be a repeat winner...[/p][p]• Added the World 7 portal to the right-side World 6 town, so you can stare lustfully into its beauty as you await the trials and tribulations that lie ahead...[/p][p]• Added 1 new Tome entry, giving 300+ Tome PTS based on the total number of Summoning Bosses you've won against![/p][p]• Added quests for Potti, with the final quest awarding "Heroic Spirit", the World 6 TROPHY!
• New Limited-time Gemshop items! 3 FREEBIES this time, thanks to Walter -- one 5* cardifier, and two ribbons![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/oIFsuST.png"][/img][/p][p]• Arcane Cultist's Family Bonus is now DMG Multi (true multiplier, not additive with other multipliers), instead of +% Fighting AFK gains, since Vman already had that one.[/p][p]• "Next Vial" display in Alchemy is now called "Next Vials" and cycles through the next 4 possible vial ingredients in a satisfying manner.[/p][p]• You can now scroll up and down in Talents to change the tab you're viewing.[/p][p]• \[New Players only] Added mini-tutorials to Pet Battles, construction building, Cog Board, taking samples for the 3d printer, Item Dropping for Vials, using the scrollbars to buy more sailing captains and boats, finding vault in quickref, farming crops and evolving to new crops, strumming the Harp, not equipping Gold Charms in Sneaking, getting new spices, using the refinery, Worship tower defense,[/p][p]• Improved the UI display for Card-Sets, Divinity Unlinking, kitchen upgrading, equipping big bubbles[/p][p]• Made page-changing arrow buttons more obvious for kitchen, forge, trapping[/p][p]• The (?) Helper info for both "Arcanist Weapons" and "Arcanist Rings" Tesseract Upgrades now shows how many of the 100/day limit are left to drop! [/p][p]• Chat rings now change the chat boxes of all NPCs, not just your own![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/54xWiUK.png"][/img][/p][p]• Territory Fight Power as a mechanic has been REMOVED. Combat pets (the red ones) no longer have a use in Territories to gather spices, only the Foraging pets do (the green ones).[/p][p]• Blooming Axe pet breeding upgrade no longer gives Territory Fight Power. Instead, it gives Pet Damage.[/p][p]• Unlocking critters via Lord of the Hunt as a mechanic has been REMOVED. You now have access to all critters from the start -- although you still need to reach their respective maps of course. Instead, Lord of the Hunt gives +10% Critter Gain for every quest of his you complete. [/p][p]• Changed "Auto Refine" to be a toggle. It's either OFF, or its ON, in which case it will refine into salt whenever it has any Power at all.[/p][p]• Removed the 'lava skull' rift challenge completely, replaced with the 'skull points' challenges.[/p][p]• Snowman mob drops Green Tachyons instead of Purple, since the previous mob also dropped the same amount of Purple it was redundant. [/p][p]• Buffed the base chance to find pristine charms by 1.5x, but the rate gets lower as you roll for more pristine charms. This adjusted rate resets back to a 1.5x buff each day, to fit with my initial design of frequency of rolls. In other words, if you are finding a few dozen ninja items a day, this is a strict buff for you.[/p][p]• Completely changed "Inviting a Plus One" Tesseract Upgrade scaling. An inconceivably more magnanimous cost scaling (that means cheaper), and a much higher max upgrade level. [/p][p]• Arcane Kills needed to break the Biggole Wurm Barrier (9th map of World 4) lowered from 70 to 30.[/p][p]• Arcane Kills needed to break the Purple Mushroom Barrier (1st map of World 4) lowered from 70 to 45.[/p][p]• Arcane Kills needed to break World 5 Barriers on your Arcane Cultist has been lowered from 170 to 80.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/obMaal8.png"][/img][/p][p]• Fixed the error platforms on Neyeptune map at the end of W3[/p][p]• Fixed an issue were Combat and Forage pets could be placed in Fenceyard. Now it really is just Breedability and Shiny pets allowed.[/p][p]• Fixed an issue where the trimmed construction slot from the recent event not giving its full bonus, while correctly appearing visually.[/p][p]• Fixed the Grimoire upgrades Wraith Damage V, Wraith Accuracy V, and Wraith Defence V giving the incorrect bonus amount.[/p][p]• Fixed an issue where Tesseract Upgrade Verdon Hoarding (+% Tachyon Gain per POW 10 green tachions owned) was giving an incorrect bonus amount.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206668/d1b2fc14c354fe7af422645cd5cd5479d8c6b91a.png"][/img]
[i]Those were the winners from last Patch Notes! GL GL to everyone entering this time![/i][/p][p]Every patch notes, I give away 5000 GEMS to people who leave their 1st IdleOn username in the COMMENTS! While you're doing that, [b]go leave a Steam Review![/b] It won't help for winning gems, but it would be freakin' cool if you did! ːgp_coolː[/p][p][/p][p]~LavaFlame2[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Charred Bones & Medallions!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eGlPrzq.png[/img]
[b]Collect 1000 charred fragments on your Deathbringer, and you'll get 1 Charred Bone per hour, FOREVER![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xZ4O5ki.png[/img]
[b]Charred Bones give 1hr of Deathbringer Bones, based on the BONES/hr displayed in your AFK Gains.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/guhHJqa.png[/img]
[b]View your Medallion Collection by assigning the Shiny Medallions to your attack bar! It's just like the Compass talent now, you gotta USE it![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JOJ2amN.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tcf4Rek.png[/img]
[b]Buy the limited-time Eternal Hunter bundle in the Gemshop to get your very own SPIRIT REINDEER PET![/b] 
The Reindeer is tradeable, so you can gift one to your friend AND keep yours! ːSmile_IdleOnː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EPssMcs.png[/img]
• Collect 1000 charred bone Fragments on Deathbringer to unlock AFK bone collecting! Once unlocked, you will get 1 Charred Bone per HR of afk gains claimed on your Deathbringer, which each Charred Bone giving 1hr of Bones when used, similar to Aethermoons. The only difference will be that you use up the entire stack of Charred Bones at once, so you don't need to click 100s of times. 
• View your Medallion collection by USING the Shiny Medallion talent on your Windwalker! Yes, you need to assign the Shiny Medallion talent to your attack bar, just like you do for Compass talent.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oIFsuST.png[/img]
• Changed the "Shiny Medallions" talent to be an Active talent. When used, it shows which mobs you've collected medallions from, and which you havent! I'm repeating myself here, but for good reason, some people will still be confused by how to access the medallion collection! Unfortunately for you and me both, these people don't read patch notes so you'll have to help spread the word... maybe through pictures, or voice recordings?
• Aethermoons do NOT drop dust at your feet anymore. It just ADDS the dust STRAIGHT to your Compass, no fuss no sus.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/54xWiUK.png[/img]
• You can now only get 250 Tempest Weapon/Ring Drops while visiting a map, after which they will stop dropping. This is to prevent overnight AFK-ing from lagging due to having 1000s of unlootable weapon drops. NOTE: Stones and medallions WILL keep dropping always. If you want more Weapons/Rings to drop, simply leave and re-enter the map -- changing Servers will accomplish this too. I felt this would be a more convenient change than requiring the player to juggle between different loot filter options.
• Adjusted which mobs can and can't drop Medallions, and removed medallions that are now impossible to get from all players. Most notably, these include Bug Hive medallions.
• Adjusted how late-game tower defence works. Waves now auto-complete after 9999 seconds, however you CANT "save" unless all mobs are dead.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/obMaal8.png[/img]
• Fixed Maestro crashing in World 4 town on Android!
• Fixed Wisdom monument's Memory Game crashing sometimes in latest version
• Fixed Reindeer signpost disappearing when swapping maps. It now functions just like Deathbringer Gravestone and Siegebreaker's Flag, where it 'follows' you as you move maps, but it does of course lose its current killcount.
• You can now find "Grass Element" Tempst Bows - the first one drops from Snelbies in World 2, and can also be found from mobs in World 4 and World 6.
• You can now find "Wind Element" Tempst Rings - the first one drops from Pincermin in World 2, and can also be found from mobs in World 4 and World 6.
• The 4th Anniversary inventory slot bag now properly applies to newly created characters. This will work retroactively, but you need to directly login with the newly created player who was missing the bag.
• Fixed an issue where two Gold Charms from Master II+ were missing from Ninja Drop Tables.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/0dbqWSq.png[/img]
Every patch notes, I give away GEMS to people who leave their 1st idleon username in the COMMENTS! 

Those were the 15 people won 5000 gems ːcrystalː Congratulations to them, and good luck to everyone entering this time around!

~Charredflame2

notes.title: PET TRADING!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pHDijSj.png[/img]
[h2]Trades are always between YOUR FOLLOWER PET, and THEIR FOLLOWER PET[/h2]

[b][u]How to choose a follower:[/u] Go to Dog in World 1. Now, click Manage in the top-left. Now, click Select Pet Follower in top-right. Select follower![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pjQSzhF.png[/img]

ːSmile_IdleOnː [b]When you trade a pet with someone, you KEEP YOUR PET [i](in untradeable form)[/i], while receiving their pet in untradeable form also[/b]

ːHeart_IdleOnː [b]You can trade your pet to someone for nothing in return. They will get the pet [i](untradeable)[/i], and you KEEP YOUR PET [i](untradeable)[/i], meaning you can essentially Gift your pets to friends![/b]

[h2]For example:[/h2]
[b]If I trade my Rift Slug for your Ram, I will end up with an Untradeable Slug and Untradeable Ram.
You will end up with an Untradeable Ram and Untradeable Slug.[/b]



🐘 The elephant in the room asks:  [b]"Why not just do a normal trading system.... You get their pet, and they get yours?"[/b]

1. This "pet duplication" actually LETS you use trading! What normally happens (for me) in trading is that I get a super powerful item, keep it forever, never end up trading it, and then eventually quit -- in other words, it's as if trading didn't even exist! This way, you can actually engage in trading your most powerful pets, since you end up keeping a copy!

2. Because that would open the door for scams, fraud, phishing, social engineering, hacked accounts, and every black-market force that plagues other MMOs. Players would be under constant duress both in-game and in discord, getting fake links from hackers trying to hijack your account so they can sell your pets. Having pets become untradeable removes the incentive and value for bad actors, while giving that EXTRA value to the real players who actually play idleon!

3. More pets for all -- I know some people were hoping to become a "merchant" (constantly trading pets around in the hopes of 'trading up' to the top tier pets, like that guy who trade a paperclip into a house over years), but most people just want more pets, period. This system doubles the amount of pets in game. For every 1 doot pull, thats TWO doots that enter the playerbase!

4. Allows for generosity -- In a normal trading system, you would NEVER give your best items to your friends. Ever. Only if you got duplicates. But because this system lets you trade a pet for no pet in return, you can essentially GIFT your best pets to your best friends, since you keep yours!

--------------------

[h3]Now, as for future pets, to me its very simple:[/h3]
[b]Pet accumulation is fun.
Getting bonuses is fun.
Choosing which rotations and having new pets to use your freebie on each week is fun.[/b]

Buuuut... there are a few things that are not fun: huge requirements to hit the pity, and bonuses that feel too integral to progression. 
I stand by the fact that no current pets are required for progression in the same way that buying a DLC is literally required for progression in a game with DLC, but I would have liked doot, ram, and sheepie to be less integral.

[h3]As such, future pets will all be number-bonuses. [/h3]
+% Library checkout speed, +X% build rate, +X% class EXP, +X% Ninja Stealth, you get the idea. 
No "[insert feature] now operates in a different/better way", like with bubbles / storage / divinities 

ːIdleOnː  [b]IdleOn was, is, and always will be at its best when the juicy Game-Changing bonuses are tied to content, like you find in Alchemy, Construction, Lab, Sailing, Gaming, Jade Emporium, Summoning, and future world 7 skills.[/b] I think these changes will be perfect in making pets the system it was always meant to be.

notes.title: Error with Closing / Memory Leak FIXED!
notes.content:
[b]IdleOn will now properly close when exited, and will not slow your computer down after failing to close (since it won't fail to close anymore)[/b]

[b]If you just care about playing, you can stop reading and GO PLAY!! :D[/b]
-
[i]Are you the Rick of your 'Rick and Morty' viewer group? Do you want an in-depth, detailed explanation of what was happening? Then keep reading![/i]

[u]In-depth explanation of the issue[/u]
While the main container process and child utility processes (e.g. for sound and network) closed correctly when exiting the game, the child renderer process (that displays the game) would sometimes remain open and continue trying to draw and run the game: hence the high CPU & memory usage. 
I've put the renderer process in a sandbox now so it should require the main process & now should be required to close when the main process ends. This way, when you exit the game, you'll never end up in a situation like before where the child renderer process remains open"

[i][/i]

notes.title: [BUG INFO] IdleOn sometimes doesn't fully close
notes.content:
[b]Sometimes IdleOn doesn't fully close when you exit, [/b]and continues to churn until you kill it in the Task Manager.
[b]This is a bug and something that I am working to fix hopefully before the weekend is over![/b]
-
Apart from that, please do keep in mind this game is [b]IN EARLY ACCESS.[/b]
[list]
[*] If you're having fun, plan on coming back at final launch, or just don't enjoy the gameplay, great! Those are all very valid, and I can appreciate anyone who reaches any of these conclusions.
[*] If you don't plan on coming back because you think this is a finished product that will never change or get better, please maybe slightly change your mind on that -- almost everything I see people suggest is something that I either totally agree with needs to be in the game, or something I already had plans to address with future content (like an auto-loot system)!
[/list]

Thanks everyone for a super fun launch day, and again I'm hoping to get those critical bug fixes done within a few days!

Cheers,
Lava
